rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for cleaning a surface with a broom or brush.

example.english: I sweep the living-room floor every morning.
example.traditional: 我每日朝早都掃客廳地板。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 dou1 sou3 haak3 teng1 dei6 baan2

rows.note: Use this when wind, an object, or a rapidly moving person or thing passes lightly or swiftly across a place.

example.english: The wind seems to sweep lightly across the sea and past us.
example.traditional: 一陣風吹過海面，輕輕掠過我哋身邊。
example.jyutping: jat1 zan6 fung1 ceoi1 gwo3 hoi2 min6 heng1 heng1 loek6 gwo3 ngo5 dei6 san1 bin1

rows.note: Use this when something is swept away or removed completely and abruptly, rather than merely cleaned.

example.english: The downpour can sweep all the rubbish off the beach in one go.
example.traditional: 場暴雨將沙灘上啲垃圾一嘢掃走晒。
example.jyutping: coeng4 bou6 jyu5 zoeng1 saa1 taan1 soeng6 di1 laap6 saap3 jat1 je5 sou3 zau2 saai3
